item.title: About Us
item.description: 99 Nights Guide Hub is a fan-made guide website for 99 Nights in the Forest, the co-op survival horror game on Roblox. What we do Working codes — updated monthly and re-verified whenever the game updates. Survival guides — day-by-day routes for your first 10 nights, campfire and base upgrades. Classes, monsters and advanced systems — tier lists, counter strategies, crafting, fishing, taming and hard mode. Video archive — a growing library of quest walkthroughs, boss guides and update coverage.

item.title: Contact
item.description: We read every message. Contact us for: Guide corrections — found a code that stopped working, or a number that is wrong? Tell us and we will fix it with the next update. Feedback — what helped you, what we should cover next. Video submissions — want your walkthrough featured in the video archive? Advertising and partnerships. Email 39918849@qq.com — we usually reply within a few days. Player feedback Prefer the quick form?

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: 99 Nights Guide Hub (“we”, “us”) operates the website at https://www.portalaser.com. This page explains what information is collected when you visit the site and how it is used. Information we collect No account data. The site does not require registration, and we do not collect names, email addresses or payment information from visitors. Feedback you send. If you send feedback through the contact or feedback form, the message (including any name you include) is sent to us by email and used only to respond and improve the site.
